final_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT breed_code, COUNT(*) n FROM Dogs GROUP BY breed_code) SELECT b.breed_name, c.n, d.name, t.date_of_treatment FROM c JOIN Breeds b ON b.breed_code=c.breed_code JOIN Dogs d ON d.breed_code=c.breed_code LEFT JOIN Treatments t ON t.dog_id=d.dog_id WHERE c.n=(SELECT MIN(n) FROM c) ORDER BY d.name, t.date_of_treatment LIMIT 50
